## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: mixed internals — Industrials, Real Estate and Consumer Staples are ABOVE TREND while Technology, Communication and many large Financials read as BELOW TREND; Top 5 leaders concentrated across 3 sectors — style mixed / no clear leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Real Estate leads: AMT (1W: +8.94% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND, CCI (1W: +8.61% | 1M: +3.38%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples strong: MO (1W: +7.35% | 1M: +6.00%) ABOVE TREND, PM (1W: +6.77% | 1M: +10.92%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials follow: LMT (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +22.09%) ABOVE TREND, RTX (1W: +7.12% | 1M: +12.22%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging overall: AAPL (1W: -1.48% | 1M: -6.95%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -4.05% | 1M: -3.47%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -12.63% | 1M: -10.76%) BELOW TREND. Communication and Financials weak: TMUS (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -5.90%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -9.89% | 1M: -10.19%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -5.08% | 1M: -0.53%) BELOW TREND, WFC (1W: -7.89% | 1M: -4.13%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: AMD (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +10.83%) ABOVE TREND, AMT (1W: +8.94% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND, CCI (1W: +8.61% | 1M: +3.38%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +8.58% | 1M: +26.34%) ABOVE TREND, MO (1W: +7.35% | 1M: +6.00%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors represented) — gains clustered in Tech (semi), Real Estate and Consumer Staples.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: BKNG (1W: -6.85% | 1M: -5.90%) BELOW TREND, TMUS (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -5.90%) BELOW TREND, WFC (1W: -7.89% | 1M: -4.13%) BELOW TREND, ISRG (1W: -8.74% | 1M: -3.53%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -9.89% | 1M: -10.19%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Communication and select Tech/Travel names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W momentum: AMD (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +10.83%) ABOVE TREND, AMT (1W: +8.94% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND, CCI (1W: +8.61% | 1M: +3.38%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +8.58% | 1M: +26.34%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +22.09%) ABOVE TREND. Watch NOW (1W: -10.22% | 1M: -18.51%) BELOW TREND where bullish headline (+55) diverges sharply from price — distribution/flow risk.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is mixed and under pressure: AMD (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +10.83%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +8.58% | 1M: +26.34%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +4.79%) ABOVE TREND while AAPL (1W: -1.48% | 1M: -6.95%) BELOW TREND and MSFT (1W: -4.05% | 1M: -3.47%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W: -2.14% | 1M: +0.19% — internal rotation inside Tech.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are bifurcated: BLK (1W: +7.19% | 1M: +8.90%) ABOVE TREND and some positive news flow, while JPM (1W: -5.08% | 1M: -0.53%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -6.14% | 1M: -4.87%) BELOW TREND and WFC (1W: -7.89% | 1M: -4.13%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W: -1.25% | 1M: +0.38% — watch for earnings/interest-driven dispersion.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare mixed between defensive strength and pockets of weakness: JNJ (1W: +6.98% | 1M: +4.47%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +0.67% | 1M: +0.47%) ABOVE TREND, vs ISRG (1W: -8.74% | 1M: -3.53%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -1.51%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W: -0.93% | 1M: +1.68% — defensive names showing selective leadership.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Real Estate, Industrials and Consumer Staples exposure given ABOVE TREND leadership in AMT (1W: +8.94% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +22.09%) ABOVE TREND and MO (1W: +7.35% | 1M: +6.00%) ABOVE TREND. Reduce exposure to pressured large-cap Tech and Communication names such as AAPL (1W: -1.48% | 1M: -6.95%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -4.05% | 1M: -3.47%) BELOW TREND and CHTR (1W: -9.89% | 1M: -10.19%) BELOW TREND; style mixed — monitor for clearer leadership before re-risking broadly.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AMD (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +10.83%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +8.58% | 1M: +26.34%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +22.09%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ADBE (1W: -11.33% | 1M: -14.88%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -15.71% | 1M: -18.38%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -9.89% | 1M: -10.19%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Industrials (1W: +3.43% | 1M: +9.75%) — watch aerospace/defense names; Real Estate (1W: +4.41% | 1M: +4.70%) — watch AMT/CCI flow. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -2.14% | 1M: +0.19%) and Communication (1W: -3.79% | 1M: -3.79%) — monitor downside continuation.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +4.79%) ABOVE TREND — weekly follow-through above recent 1M highs would confirm continuation. AAPL (1W: -1.48% | 1M: -6.95%) BELOW TREND — failure to reclaim the 1M trend would risk deeper rotation. AMAT (1W: +8.58% | 1M: +26.34%) ABOVE TREND — sustained weekly closes above the breakout range would signal broader semi-cycle strength. WFC (1W: -7.89% | 1M: -4.13%) BELOW TREND — watch for momentum reversal or further downside on missed catalysts.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
NOW (+55): NOW (1W: -10.22% | 1M: -18.51%) BELOW TREND — headline on OpenAI partnership is bullish but price is diverging (distribution). META (+50): META (1W: -5.02% | 1M: -5.62%) BELOW TREND — upbeat growth commentary is not yet confirmed by price. WFC (+50): WFC (1W: -7.89% | 1M: -4.13%) BELOW TREND — positive NII outlook contrasts with steep recent weakness.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
ADBE (-50): ADBE (1W: -11.33% | 1M: -14.88%) BELOW TREND — negative headlines confirm price deterioration. INTU (-50): INTU (1W: -15.71% | 1M: -18.38%) BELOW TREND — downgrade-driven selling is confirmed by momentum. CCI (-50): CCI (1W: +8.61% | 1M: +3.38%) ABOVE TREND — JPM price-target cut is a bearish signal but price is rising, a clear divergence to monitor.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. AMD (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +10.83%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +8.58% | 1M: +26.34%) ABOVE TREND and AMT (1W: +8.94% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: Tech and Communication weakness plus noticeable sentiment divergences (NOW bullish headlines vs steep price declines; CCI bearish note while ABOVE TREND) — monitor for confirmation before broad re-risking.
